text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a rolling reboot + preheat in us-west1 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. NIC firmware + GPU driver security backport. Proposal: 20% cohort drains, KV-cache prewarm, leave Dedicated pools pinned to avoid SLA churn. Need to hedge capacity so hosted customers don't see latency spikes. Any red flags?
sam: SGTM. One callout — APAC quotas are still tight and we can't shift much there. Can we keep a small burst pool open and bump prewarm duration to 30s for hot cohorts?
chris: +1. Also saw a NIC flap yesterday on rack-7 that triggered connection retries -> watch egress queues. Suggest we avoid moving control-plane pods during the window and apply a temporary netpol to reduce churn. cc @oncall
devops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance/6192468100-us-west1. Reminder set for 01:30 UTC.
noah: Quick cost FYI: prewarming ~30s per node roughly adds $0.06/hr/node (ballpark). If we prewarm 200 nodes that's ~ $12/hr. We should decide tradeoff prewarm vs risk of repeated cold-start latency. Could reduce by seeding KV only for top 5 tenants.
leo: If we keep Dedicated pools pinned, that limits customer impact. Recommend canary on a non-critical tenant first (5 nodes) then ramp.
maria: Updated plan: canary cohort (5 nodes) at 01:55 UTC, then 20% cohorts every 10 minutes. Prewarm script will run prior to cordon. Drain command (example):
```
# cordon + drain example
kubectl cordon node/gpu-node-123
kubectl drain node/gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# prewarm KV cache
./scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --nodes gpu-node-123 --duration 30
```
chris: Please add runbook link to the maintenance doc and watch for this log pattern if NIC flap recurs:
```
[2026-03-21T01:41:12Z] net/eth0: link reset detected, tx_retries=142, rx_err=3
[2026-03-21T01:41:13Z] kubelet: pod sync failed: network error -> retry
```
sam: I'll own monitoring during window — I'll set alerts for 95p latency > 350ms (text-gen routes), GPU util > 98%, and packet-loss > 1%. Will post updates here every cohort.
maria: I'll draft customer comms for Dedicated SLA owners and post to #customer-success. @noah can you sign off on the estimated cost impact so I can include in the comms?
noah: Ok, approve budget for this one-off window. Keep prewarm targets tight (top tenants only) to minimize spend. :thumbsup:
leo: Canary scheduled ✅. I'll stage the fallback image in case we need rapid rollback.
maria: Great — team, let's meet in #eng-oncall 01:40 UTC for quick preflight. Plan pinned in ops/maintenance/6192468100 (link will be posted). Thanks all.
